lines: Timid as I am, thrown off by the wind
The phantom of that day drifts past me
The truth is, more than I appear
I have a past that cries easily
O clear water, flowing without end
O demonic fire, burning though I try to quench it
A summer when I'd meet
a woman I loved that much will never come again
Everyone seeks love
a fate wandering in the dark
And left to the wind, oh, my destiny
until my tears run dry
When our eyes meet, I can't speak honestly
Before a loneliness like a tsunami
I know... I'm trembling
From the moment we met
the spell has never broken
Inside a dream like a mirror
my memories are rain, every day
When the dream ends and I wake
dawn comes to the deep dark
The truth is, more than I appear
there's a me who takes a beating and stands back up
Gazing at a sky about to burst into tears
a gull drifting on the waves
Surely the world has mercy, oh, sweet memory
With departure held in my chest
No one becomes an adult without showing tears
That this love is like glass
I know... I'm aware
Body and soul
I can see no one but the woman I love
Deep in a chest about to burst
why do I endure the sorrow?
When our eyes meet, I can't
speak honestly
Before a loneliness like a tsunami
I know... I'm trembling
From the moment we met, say you'll love me until you die
Inside a dream like a mirror
who was it who gave me that smile?
Why did I cry, when I love her?
My memories are, every day... rain
